# Spring Forward

Spring Forward is a lilac-pink Earth pony with a curled pale-yellow mane and tail, green eyes, and usually a three-carrot cutie mark (occasionally an hourglass). She is a recurring *Friendship is Magic* background mare, especially recognizable as one of the ice-scoring skaters in Ponyville's “Winter Wrap Up.” Similar-looking ponies such as Golden Harvest are not confirmed alternate identities. [Series appearance record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Spring_Forward).

**Name and voice.** She is never named in the television dialogue. Enterplay's licensed *Premiere* collectible card #61R names her **Spring Forward, Companionable Filly**; its [early official card reference](https://img3.wikia.nocookie.net/__cb20140426224212/mylittleponyccg/images/d/d4/MLP_CCG_Official_Card_Reference_%28v1.0%29.pdf) says “[was Romana],” documenting an earlier card-list name, not a secret identity. Gameloft separately uses **Eager Ice Skater** and **Spring Forward** for versions of her design ([game variation index](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Variations_of_characters)). No individually attributable spoken lines or voice actor are verified; being shown conversing does not establish an audible role.

**Where to spot her.** She flees Nightmare Moon in S1E2, skates in S1E11, admires Mare Do Well in S2E8, attends the Canterlot wedding (S2E26) and Twilight's coronation (S3E13), decorates Canterlot (S4E1), attends Coloratura's concert (S5E24), appears beside Prim Posy on Restaurant Row (S6E12), and is visible at the Friendship Festival in the 2017 film. These are mostly background appearances, not a personal story arc.

**Verified image — licensed Hasbro/Enterplay card artwork**, shown on a CCGCastle product page; individual illustrator not established:

[![Spring Forward — Companionable Filly collectible card](https://www.ccgcastle.com/uploads/item/image/springforward61.jpg)](https://www.ccgcastle.com/product/my-little-pony/premiere/spring-forward-companionable-filly)

## Important moments

1. **Skating winter away — “Winter Wrap Up” (S1E11).** Spring Forward joins the ice scorers cutting the frozen lake into sections to help bring spring, the activity most closely associated with her name. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RkMt7dfvJyk); exact scene timestamp not independently verified.
2. **Preparing the celebration — “Princess Twilight Sparkle – Part 1” (S4E1).** She helps decorate Canterlot for the Summer Sun Celebration, one of her clearer contributions beyond crowd attendance. [Licensed episode listing](https://www.nowtv.com/watch/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/iYEQYZ6ymh22BCLb91Vd3m/seasons/4/episodes/princess-twilight-sparkle-part-1-episode-1/A5EK3JYiLcaCh6gefN59Q); scene timestamp unavailable.
